jobs.description_text: 2009년 설립된 클로버추얼패션은 3D 의상 시뮬레이션 알고리즘에 대한 독보적인 기술력을 바탕으로, 디지털 패션의 새로운 생태계를 만들어 가고 있습니다. 의상 디자인 소프트웨어 CLO, Marvelous Designer, Jinny와 함께, CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 플랫폼으로 의상의 모든 여정에 관여하여 효율적이고 지속가능한 워크플로우를 구축하고 있습니다. 뿐만 아니라, 당사 솔루션을 통해 실제 의상과 디지털 의상이 서로 태그되어 CLO 시스템 내에서 기능할 수 있게끔 합니다. 글로벌 디지털 패션 시장을 주도하고 있는 클로버추얼패션은 현재 아시아, 북미, 유럽, 남미 등 전 세계 12개국에 총 16개의 오피스를 두고 있으며, 세계 각국의 수많은 고객사를 바탕으로 점점 확장해나가고 있습니다. [CLO의 소프트웨어] CLO:https://www.clo3d.com Marvelous Designer:https://www.marvelousdesigner.com Jinny:https://connect.clo-set.com/jinny [CLO의 플랫폼] CLO-SET:https://style.clo-set.com/aboutus CONNECT:https://connect.clo-set.com/ [전세계 디자이너의 일하는 방식을 바꿔놓은 회사 - EO] https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RG8LFEKg1D8 [클로버추얼패션 채용 홈페이지] https://www.clovirtualfashion-careers.com/ Position Overview 클로버추얼패션의 Finance & Accounting Chapter는 회사의 숫자가 정확하고 투명하게 기록되도록 하고, 이를 바탕으로 회사가 올바른 의사결정을 내리고 지속적으로 성장할 수 있도록 돕습니다. 회사의 다음 성장 단계를 준비하는 여러 프로젝트를 진행함에 있어, 실무의 멤버로 참여하며 재무 전반의 경험을 함께하실 Accounting Associate를 선발합니다. 금번 포지션은 법인카드 및 일반비용 관리, 국내 매출 대사, 자금 반제 처리 등의 실무를 주도하며 데이터의 정합성을 높입니다. 특히, AI 네이티브 환경에 맞추어 단순 반복 업무와 서류 작업을 자동화하고 재무 워크플로우의 생산성을 극대화하는 과정을 함께할 분을 찾습니다. jobs.description_text: CLO Virtual Fashion is redefining the future of apparel through cutting-edge 3D clothing simulation technology—powering the entire fashion lifecycle from concept and design to production, marketing, fitting, and styling. Our suite of tools—including CLO, Marvelous Designer, and Jinny—streamlines every stage of the garment creation process, while platforms like CLO-SET and CONNECT enable seamless collaboration, content management, and digital asset workflows. Through smart tagging technology, CLO also links physical and digital garments, creating an integrated and intelligent fashion infrastructure built for the future of design and sustainability. CLO Virtual Fashion, a global leader in digital fashion innovation, operates across 16 offices in 13 countries—including key hubs in Asia, North America, Europe, and South America. As the demand for immersive, tech-driven fashion solutions grows, CLO continues to expand its global footprint, powered by a rapidly growing international user base and a future-focused vision. The role defines and executes integrated product, marketing and digital strategies across the cardholder journey to drive onboarding, activation, engagement, product usage, retention, loyalty and long-term customer engagement. Combining product knowledge, deep marketing expertise and business acumen, the Senior Manager translates customer insights, portfolio priorities and market opportunities into an actionable lifecycle roadmap. The role partners closely with Product, Digital, Marketing, Data and Analytics, Operations and Finance and teams to deliver coordinated customer experiences and measurable business outcomes. The successful candidate will possess a unique blend of marketing strategy, product, and analytical expertise, coupled with exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills. Working collaboratively with internal teams and external partners, they will lead the development of customer-centric engagement strategies, align stakeholders around shared business objectives, and identify innovative opportunities to strengthen customer relationships and accelerate portfolio growth.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager (18 Month Contract)
jobs.description_text: The Senior Technical Program Manager (STPM) reports to the Director, Technical Program Management. The STPM owns end-to-end plan management and delivery execution for highly complex technical programs across EQ Bank's Digital Banking ecosystem, with a strong emphasis on measurable business value, customer outcomes, reliability, and usability. The STPM leads execution across multiple interdependent teams and domains, proactively surfaces technical and non-technical risks, establishes mitigation plans, manages complex dependencies, drives decisions, and enables alignment across Engineering, Product, Business, Enterprise partners, and third parties. The STPM applies company policies and Enterprise Change Management requirements while balancing governance with modern product and technology delivery practices. The STPM operates effectively where scope, ownership, or the delivery path is ambiguous. The role is expected to build strong cross-functional relationships, influence senior stakeholders without authority, resolve escalated delivery constraints, and provide clear executive-level visibility of program health, trade-offs, and decisions.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Infrastructure Solutions (12 month contract)
jobs.description_text: The Work The Staff Engineer plays a key role within the Infrastructure Solutions team, defining infrastructure strategies and roadmaps with a strong emphasis on network engineering initiatives. This role will involve finalizing designs and technical implementations that align with the architecture established by the Enterprise Architecture function, ensuring optimal use of technology within the organization. The specialist will contribute to the development of policies, processes, and procedures for Infrastructure & Operations (I&O) and provide expert advice on technology utilization to enhance overall enterprise value. In addition to these responsibilities, the position will focus on creating robust network architectures and developing high-level designs that meet business requirements. This includes designing network topologies, selecting appropriate technologies, and producing detailed documentation. The specialist will collaborate with various teams, including Azure Cloud Operations and business unit infrastructure requirements, to ensure alignment with organizational objectives while supporting high-level infrastructure needs across the enterprise.

jobs.description_text: Who We Are Intropic is a fast-growing, venture-backed information company. We believe information helps people make better decisions and fuels innovation, and we build software and data products that help people get more value from it. Our journey starts in finance and capital markets, where information moves trillions of dollars: our index rebalance forecasting, index intelligence and related datasets are already used daily by Portfolio Managers, Traders and Researchers at some of the world's largest hedge funds, asset managers and trading firms. We're just getting started. We are now opening our first office in Asia-Pacific, in Hong Kong. Our APAC client base of quantitative funds, trading firms and sell-side institutions across Hong Kong, Japan and Singapore has grown to the point where it needs specialist support during its own market hours rather than from London. This hire is a founding member of that presence. You will be backed by the full weight of our London headquarters in Canary Wharf: our research, engineering, product and commercial teams, established processes and a client book that already spans the region. In other words, start-up ownership and visibility with the backing of an established, well-capitalised business behind you. Who We Look For We want people with strong analytical skills, a genuine interest in financial markets, an entrepreneurial drive and a desire to have an impact. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (EMEA)
jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments. Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Maga

jobs.title: FPGA Digital Design Engineer
jobs.description_text: We’re on the hunt for a top-tier FPGA Digital Design Engineer to develop the next generation of our satellites. At Kepler, you’ll have the opportunity to work with a dedicated team of engineers building the Kepler spacecraft. You will be responsible for the design and implementation of FPGA code either with a focus on DSP algorithms to modulate and demodulate signals on board our software defined radio (SDR), or embedded systems interfacing with processors and peripherals. To be effective you will need to participate in all phases of FPGA design flow (Simulation, Synthesis, Place & Route, Timing Closure and Hardware Testing). A good understanding of the intricacies of FPGA development would make a candidate standout.

You will translate program objectives into executable technical plans, aligning requirements, architecture, interfaces, trade studies, verification evidence, and risk decisions across a large cross-functional team. Experience with constellation-level architectures, multi-satellite delivery, or cross-program technical execution is a strong asset. This role requires strong systems engineering judgment, the ability to lead through ambiguity, and the communication discipline to align teams and stakeholders while balancing technical integrity with cost, schedule, risk, mission assurance, and customer expectations. Through our AI surfaces, MCP server, which can be used within tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and enterprise copilots, and our AI Assistant embedded in the Kpler terminal, customers can ask questions in natural language and receive analysis grounded in Kpler data. We are looking for a technically minded, customer-facing Sales Specialist – AI Products to support the adoption and growth of Kpler's AI offering globally. You will work closely with prospects and existing customers, demonstrating how our AI products can address their specific needs, integrate into their existing technology environments and deliver tangible commercial value. Acting as the technical counterpart to our Commercial teams, you will lead customer demonstrations, design and deliver workshops, support integrations and help customers understand the capabilities, value and security of our AI products. You will also play an important role in shaping the AI product roadmap through direct customer feedback and market insights.

jobs.title: Sales Specialist – Dry Bulk
jobs.description_text: As a Sales Specialist in Kpler’s Commercial team, you will be responsible for developing Kpler’s Dry Bulk sales penetration across the EMEA region, with a focus on Metals, Mining, Agriculture and Freight. You will act as a key growth engine for Kpler’s Dry Bulk suite of solutions, opening new markets, winning new logos, and identifying opportunities to grow revenue across both new and existing clients. You will manage a defined book of business and own the sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through to pitching, negotiation and closing. Working closely with Sales, Research, Marketing and Business Unit teams, you will develop a deep understanding of the Dry Bulk market and Kpler’s offering, using this knowledge to position our solutions as strategic tools for clients and strengthen our market position across EMEA. Reporting to the Dry Bulk Sales Specialist Team Lead, this role requires a proactive, commercially driven individual who is motivated by achieving and exceeding revenue targets.

jobs.title: Sales Specialist – Financial Flows (Americas)
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a proactive, hands-on Sales Specialist to drive adoption and growth of Kpler’s CTA and Financial Flows solutions across AMER. This role is focused on expanding the adoption of our Kpler Financial Flows (KFF, formerly Bridgeton) offerings within the region, working closely with the Product and Commercial teams to strengthen our market position and ensure consistent revenue growth across both new and existing clients. The ideal candidate will have a high level of energy and enthusiasm for engaging with senior commodity traders, a passion for commodity markets and trading strategies, and strong intellectual curiosity. Reporting to the KFF Sales Specialist Team Lead, this role requires a driven individual who can achieve and exceed targets.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst (Companies/Ownership)
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Data Analyst within our Data Platform team, you will be the subject matter expert behind Kpler’s company and ownership datasets. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, structure and ongoing development of company-level data, including ownership, management, operator and corporate hierarchy information. Your deep understanding of the maritime industry and its corporate landscape will help establish a reliable source of truth for asset ownership, supporting our wider data platform strategy and enabling other datasets, products and teams to build on consistent, trusted information. Starting with maritime companies, you will help expand our coverage over time to include other asset classes and related industries, such as ports, terminals, refineries, commodities and infrastructure. You will use your industry judgement to lead complex data investigations, identify gaps and drive improvements in data quality and coverage with a high degree of independence. While technical data skills are important, this role places particular emphasis on your industry expertise and ability to translate complex ownership structures into clear business rules and reliable data models. You will also collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Market Analysts and other Data Analysts to strengthen our data capabilities and support commercial and customer-facing teams.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Data Engineer on our Maritime Models team, you will take technical ownership of the core data pipelines and distributed storage architectures powering Kpler's vessel tracking and predictive analytics. You will design, scale, and optimize high-throughput batch and streaming pipelines that ingest raw maritime telemetry and transform it into actionable intelligence. Working with distributed NoSQL systems like Apache HBase at scale, your work directly ensures the freshness, accuracy, and reliability of the data models our global customers depend on.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Financial Flows
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Senior Data Engineer on the Financial Flows team, you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end data pipelines, predictive models, and cloud infrastructure powering Kpler’s commodity finance analytics. You will lead the modernization of our data foundation, spearheading the migration of production services to AWS and re-architecting legacy calculation engines into clean, performant Python services. Operating at the crossroads of quantitative research and cloud infrastructure, your work will directly ensure that market participants receive real-time, mission-critical insights across global commodities markets.

We specialize in ballistic missile defense and are developing Cyclops, a low-cost, mass-producible interceptor. We also produce containerized launchers and offer low-cost targets for threat replication. The future of global security depends on defensive technology that redefines cost, magazine depth, and distribution to deter and defend against evolving threats. Join us. WHAT WE LOOK FOR Mission-Driven Problem Solvers– The problems in missile defense demand ingenuity. We want engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals who approach challenges with curiosity, embrace failure as a learning opportunity, and stay focused on delivering the best solution for the mission. Total Ownership– We seek those who take full responsibility for delivering flight-ready work while recognizing that no one succeeds alone. The best engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals make their teammates better, knowing that complementary skills create force multiplication and drive mission success. The compensation range for this role is $115,000 - $250,000 This is the lowest-to-highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors

jobs.title: Internal Ballistician
jobs.description_text: Internal Ballistician DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking an experienced Ballistician to support the design, development, testing, and production of solid rocket motors (SRMs) for our interceptor system. This role is responsible for ensuring that SRM ballistic performance meets demanding missile-interception requirements while remaining manufacturable at scale. The Ballistician serves as the technical authority for SRM internal ballistics and overall booster performance. Responsibilities include developing and optimizing propellant grain designs; performing SRM performance analysis (including sensitivity to off-nominal conditions); reviewing and interpreting static-fire and flight-test data; providing technical oversight and direction to propulsion suppliers; and defining ballistic requirements and verifying compliance throughout development and production. The successful candidate will establish rigorous analytical methods while driving efficient program execution. They will work closely with propulsion, structures, aerodynamics, guidance and control, manufacturing, and systems engineering teams to ensure ballistic decisions remain aligned with system-level performance, technical baselines, and program objectives The compensation range for this role is $120,000 - $200,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

As a key interface between Long Wall and our customers, you will support program execution, customer engagement, and technical coordination, helping keep programs on schedule, on budget, and aligned with contractual requirements. You will work closely with Program Management leadership, engineering, contracts, and finance teams, government program offices, and industry partners, turning plans into schedules, tracking commitments through to closure, and ensuring customers receive clear, accurate information about program status. This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving environment and a direct path to building program management expertise. You will gain real experience with defense acquisition, from traditional contracting to newer, faster pathways such as Other Transaction (OT) agreements and rapid prototyping, along with government contracting and customer relationship management. The compensation range for this role is $109,998 - $155,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Marketing
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo’s Commercial team is building the strategy, insights, brand and infrastructure required to bring LX2006 to patients – marking Lexeo’s transition from a clinical-stage to a commercial company. We are seeking an Associate Director, Marketing to play a central role in preparing for the launch of LX2006, Lexeo’s first commercial product, anticipated in the US in 2028 and globally thereafter. Reporting to the Senior Director, Marketing, this individual will serve as the LX2006 brand lead, owning critical launch workstreams end to end – from customer insights and competitive intelligence to market development, campaigns, customer targeting and launch readiness – and working closely with cross-functional partners in Market Access/HEOR, Medical Affairs, Patient Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Legal, CMC, and Business Development (ad hoc) as part of Lexeo’s Launch Readiness Team. The role will also support early commercial planning for LX2020, Lexeo’s gene therapy candidate for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy. This is a highly visible, hands-on opportunity to build a launch from the ground up and help shape the commercial foundation of a growing clinical stage company. We welcome applications from candidates located across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.

jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is seeking a hands-on in vivo pharmacologist to build rodent models of cardiac disease and use them to de-risk targets, screen therapeutic candidates and advance our discovery pipeline. The scientist will design, perform or manage rodent studies from target validation through hit identification, working cross-functionally with In Vitro Pharmacology, Modality Engineering, and Translational Sciences to select-advance molecules. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is hiring a hands-on Modality Engineering Scientist to design, synthesize, and characterize oligonucleotides, bioconjugates, and AAV therapeutics for our discovery pipeline. The scientist will advance molecules from design through analytical characterization and handoff to in vitro and in vivo teams, working across chemistry, molecular biology, and pharmacology. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.description_text: Role Summary We are seeking a highly collaborative, hands-on Scientist II to help establish a preclinical neuroscience laboratory supporting small-molecule and protein therapeutics. The immediate priorities are rapid cellular profiling and lead selection for an advanced small-molecule enzyme program, and leadership of cellular development for a transferrin-based protein replacement project. The role will also build fit-for-purpose human neuronal models, laboratory workflows, and external partnerships. Location We welcome applications from candidates located across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.

jobs.title: Director, Defense Business Development – Europe & Middle East
jobs.description_text: Machina is looking for a Director of Defense Business Development – Europe & Middle East to establish and grow our presence with European defense primes, with the opportunity to expand into the Middle East over time. This is our first dedicated international business development role and will operate with significant autonomy. You’ll identify the programs and partners where Machina’s technologies and factories can have the greatest impact, build trusted relationships across European defense companies, and turn those relationships into technical engagements, proof-of-concept programs, qualification programs, and ultimately production opportunities, either fulfilled by Machina factories or deployed at customer sites. This is not a traditional sales role. We’re looking for someone who can operate credibly with engineers, program leaders, manufacturing teams, and senior executives and understands how complex defense systems move from development into production. You will work closely with Machina’s leadership, defense subsidiary, business development, engineering, and manufacturing teams. This is a remote position based in Europe, with significant travel throughout the region and periodic travel to Machina’s headquarters in Los Angeles. Candidates must reside in Europe.

jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Researcher – Arlington, VA
jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

jobs.description_text: The Role We're looking for an Information Security Engineer who can think broadly about how infrastructure is built, attacked, defended, and improved. You may have deep experience in one area—such as endpoint security, Active Directory, Data Loss Prevention, cloud security, identity, or detection and response—but you’re motivated by solving security problems across the environment. As an Information Security Engineer focused on infrastructure security, you'll help protect Palantir's global endpoints, servers, identity systems, applications, networks, and data flows. You'll work across teams to reduce attack surface, improve defensive controls, investigate security events, and turn security findings into durable architectural and operational improvements. This is not just a corporate security role; the adversaries we face are sophisticated. We need someone who understands both the details and the broader system: how a weakness in one part of the environment can create risk somewhere else, how controls interact, and how to build security improvements that hold up in practice.

jobs.title: Intellectual Property Counsel
jobs.description_text: The Role Palantir's in-house legal team works to proactively address legal issues so that Palantir can continue to drive positive impact in the world. Our IP Counsel are the legal backbone of Palantir's intellectual property strategy across all domains: patents, trademark, copyright, and trade secret. In this role you'll become a go-to advisor on the protection of Palantir's cutting edge technology. You'll have the opportunity to work on a wide array of intellectual property matters, including patent harvesting, portfolio development, and landscaping, trademark strategy and management, licensing and partnership agreements, open source strategy and compliance, product development issues, and strategic advice for product and business teams. Our ideal candidate has strong technical and interpersonal skills, meaning you are comfortable working with a variety of stakeholders from software developers and internal business teams, to third parties. You're able to maintain focus on the details and can take on novel, complex issues as they arise, whilst also holding the ownership and sense of responsibility needed to bring large and multi-stepped projects to completion. Although focused on intellectual property, as a member of the legal team you're excited to work on the broad range of projects that arise at a fast-paced, dynamic company.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst - US Government Security
jobs.description_text: The Role As an Operations Analyst supporting our US Government teams, you keep the mission moving by tracking and stabilizing projects, removing roadblocks, owning operational outcomes, and staying two steps ahead so the team can focus on what they do best. This role demands a varying range of responsibilities; you could be managing a classified facility and vendors one hour and scoping process improvement initiatives the next. You're a first-responder by instinct, a systems thinker by habit, someone who finds order in ambiguity, sees friction as a problem worth solving and shows up everyday with a Get Things Done mentality. Communication and attention to detail are core to how you operate, not afterthoughts. You'll be part of a high-accountability, high-expectation team that is just as invested in each other's success as they are in Palantir's mission. Feedback isn't just welcomed here, it's how we get better.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Operations Analyst
jobs.description_text: The Role As a Site Reliability Operations Analyst you are the engine behind Palantir deployments. You are responsible for crafting, implementing and executing processes to streamline workflows and reduce friction. You track and stabilise projects, remove roadblocks, and anticipate customer needs to free up our engineers to focus their time and attention on the technical problems they are best equipped to solve. This position requires a combination of project management, process optimisation, and execution skills. You are a person who loves fixing problems and always embraces the best idea, even when it is not your own.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Applied AI, Defense Applications
jobs.description_text: The Role Palantir's Defense Applied AI product team builds products that help the modern warfighter leverage AI for their most mission-critical work. You will help own the entire end to end Agent experience in our products and work relentlessly to ensure they deliver value for our users, while maintaining a high bar for quality. Your day-to-day workflow will vary, adapting to the requirements of our users and the technical challenges that arise. One day, you may find yourself collaborating with users to refine the UX of a particular workflow, the next you could be fine-tuning performance to enable low-latency or more accurate operational outcomes. Our Product Development organization is made up of small teams of Software Engineers. Each team focuses on a specific aspect of a product and work collaboratively to build cross functional capabilities, streamline user workflows and continuously improve our software's efficiency and reliability. We’re hiring engineers who are passionate about solving real-world problems and empowering both developers and end-users to work optimally. If you’re motivated to develop reliable, performant, and scalable AI products, this role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our products and the people who use them.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Internship - Query Engines
jobs.location_raw: London, United Kingdom · New York, NY
jobs.description_text: The Role We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world's hardest and most important problems. We build the data processing infrastructure that underpins Palantir Foundry, supporting applications that help hospitals care for more patients, help clinical teams coordinate timely diagnoses, and keep essential supplies moving through global disruption. You will work deep inside the systems that make this possible: how computations are represented, how query plans are optimised, how operators execute, and how data is read and written efficiently. We build on and extend Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, and Apache Iceberg, bringing advances in open-source engines and table formats into the demanding environments our customers operate in. Our work serves many products and workloads across Foundry, including no-code pipelines, interactive analysis, and the processing that keeps the Ontology up to date. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will take on real problems in our production systems. That could mean writing a new planning rule, adding a capability to a native execution engine, or making large tables faster to scan. You will see your work through design, code review, testing, and release. Correctness, compatibility, and predictable performance are central to everything we build, and you will learn how to deliver all three. Join us if you want to learn how modern data systems work from the inside and apply that knowledge to

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Internship - Sovereign AI Systems
jobs.location_raw: London, United Kingdom · New York, NY
jobs.description_text: The Role As a Software Engineer Intern on Sovereign AI Infrastructure, you will help build the systems that make AI agents useful, reliable, and governable in high-stakes operational environments. This is not a research-only internship. You’ll own a project with hands-on mentorship from experienced engineers, contributing to the systems that make production AI useful and trustworthy. That may mean working directly on agentic workflows, or on the layers they depend on: customer ontologies, context assembly, tool interfaces, agent identity or permissions, evaluations, and the core workflows that turn model outputs into real operational decisions. We are looking for interns with strong coding fundamentals and experience with AI systems. You should be excited to learn quickly, communicate clearly, and build systems where correctness, reliability, and customer trust matter. Core Responsibilities (may include) Build production software that improves how Palantir deploys, operates, evaluates, or monitors AI systems in customer-controlled environments. Contribute to infrastructure for agentic workflows, including tool use, context assembly, permissions, execution safety, observability, and debugging. Design and implement services, APIs, test harnesses, evaluation pipelines, or developer tools that make AI systems easier to operate. Work with engineers, product teams, and customer-facing teams to understand real operational problems and turn them into durable software. Debug issues ac

jobs.title: Dominican Republic Defensive Coach
jobs.description_text: DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW: The Player Development department is dedicated to fostering the comprehensive growth of our minor league players. Our mission is to advance the Boston Red Sox in pursuit of World Championships through a comprehensive and collaborative player development system. Our approach involves the creation of world-class player programs and efficiently scaling them across our player pool. Collaborating closely with other departments, we establish effective frameworks for exploration, learning, and development. Additionally, we work closely with Amateur Scouting, International Scouting, and Pro Scouting to ensure seamless player transitions into the Red Sox organization. Simply put, we strive to be the standard in player and staff development. POSITION OVERVIEW: The DR Defensive Coach is primarily responsible for the on-field implementation, execution, and tracking of evidence-based defensive and baserunning development for academy players in the DR. The candidate will play a key role in executing daily training initiatives and translating organizational priorities into a high-quality on-field training environment. This role also includes the opportunity to impact player development through player education, participating in player meetings, player feedback and other responsibilities that support the staff and players at the academy. As part of the responsibilities, the DR Defensive Coach will collaborate with players and field staff to maximize departmental buy-in.

jobs.title: DR Academy Hitting Coach
jobs.description_text: DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW: The Player Development department is dedicated to fostering the comprehensive growth of our minor league players. Our mission is to excel in optimizing talent and skill development while aligning with player and team objectives. Our approach involves the creation of world class player programs and efficiently scaling them across our player pool. Collaborating closely with baseball analytics, performance, and medical, we establish effective frameworks for experimentation and learning. Additionally, we work closely with Amateur Scouting, International Scouting, and Pro Scouting to ensure seamless player transitions into the Red Sox organization. POSITION OVERVIEW: The DR Academy Hitting Coach will work closely with the other hitting coaches, the Director of Hitting Development, and other essential staff to help implement and track player-specific offensive development plans. This is a hands-on, uniformed position that supports the daily operations related to improving player performance. We are seeking someone who is organized, detail-oriented, curious, and data-driven, with strong interpersonal and teamwork skills. The candidate should also be comfortable in a fast-paced environment, working closely with players, coaches, and other departments to ensure player success. This position will be based out of our academy in the Dominican Republic.

jobs.title: Minor League Assistant Strength and Conditioning Coach
jobs.description_text: DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW: As an organization, we place a substantial emphasis on maximizing player value through purposeful, long-term development. The Strength and Conditioning department is responsible for player evaluation, programming, innovation, and collaboration between all other departments and stakeholders to optimize on-field performance. POSITION OVERVIEW: The Boston Red Sox are looking for Assistant Strength and Conditioning Coaches for the upcoming 2027 season. Assistant S&C Coaches will report to Fort Myers, FL for Spring Training and then travel with an affiliate team until the end of the team’s competitive season. Assistant S&C Coaches will be notified of their affiliate assignments during Spring Training at the discretion of the organization. Coaches will assist in the implementation of the Boston Red Sox Strength and Conditioning, Baseball Sciences, Medical, and Nutrition programs. Travel: This position will be based out of Fort Myers, Florida during Minor League Spring Training, then based out of an assigned affiliate for the duration of the competitive season. Travel to all away games is required. Occasional travel may be required to other Red Sox affiliates, staff events, and educational opportunities.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning. The Location: Headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The Backin

jobs.description_text: ROLE OVERVIEW Pivot Energy is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Accounting Associate to support the day-to-day revenue accounting operations of our community solar portfolio. This role will be responsible for maintaining accurate payment and account records across systems, supporting recurring client fund transfers, completing account reconciliations, and preparing financial and operational reporting. As a member of the Accounting team, this position will work closely with Revenue Operations and other cross-functional partners to investigate and resolve billing and payment discrepancies, maintain accurate financial records, and improve recurring processes.The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and process-oriented, with strong Excel skills and exceptional attention to detail. They are comfortable working with large volumes of financial data, managing recurring deadlines, and identifying opportunities to improve accuracy, efficiency, and automation. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS The base salary range for this position is $85,0000-$95,000 depending on relevant experience, along with eligibility for the company’s substantial bonus plan, with a target bonus of 30% of annual salary (prorated in first year based on start date). Pivot Energy provides great work experience for all employees, placing an emphasis on company culture, and a focus on our people. To that end, Pivot offers an outstanding benefits package that includes: Excellent health/dental/vision insurance

jobs.title: Associate, Market Operations
jobs.description_text: ROLE OVERVIEW Pivot Energy is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Associate, Market Operations, to drive the community solar Subscription to Cash (STC) revenue cycle for select community solar markets within our RevOps department. This role requires a solid understanding of community solar best practices, a proven ability to deliver high-quality business results, exceptional attention to detail, and strong communication skills. The ideal candidate will bring an entrepreneurial mindset and a proactive approach to learning, ensuring continuous improvement in driving revenue growth, operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. As Associate, Market Operations, you will play a crucial role in optimizing subscription management, utility partnerships, customer experience and SunCentral platform development, while also identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, streamline processes and ensure high-quality outcomes. You’ll work closely with multifunctional project teams to manage and drive community solar subscription revenue for Pivot Energy and our clients. In this capacity, you'll be responsible for adhering to standard operating procedures, managing community solar data, supporting customers, reporting business results, escalating issues, proposing solutions and supporting other projects as assigned by your manager. jobs.title: Associate, Project Development
jobs.description_text: ROLE OVERVIEW The Project Development Associate will be involved in supporting project development efforts. The Associate will support solar site assessments for critical issues related to project development, as well as provide support for the preparation of permitting documents. The Project Development Associate will also support Developers and Directors in management of third-party contractors, preparation and execution of land use permits, public outreach, community meetings, land use hearings, interconnection studies, and critical real estate and landowner document support. There are many moving pieces to develop solar projects, and the ability to prioritize, multitask, effectively communicate, and remain highly organized is paramount. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS The estimated base salary range for this position is $70,0000-$85,000, depending on relevant experience, along with eligibility for the company’s substantial bonus plan and commission plan with a target bonus of 20% of annual salary (prorated in the first year based on start date). To that end, Pivot offers an outstanding benefits package that includes: Excellent health/dental/vision insurance benefits with up to 100% of premiums covered by the company Four weeks of vacation Company-paid life insurance and short- & long-term disability coverage Generous parental leave 401(k) matching (after vesting period) Work-from-home stipend for new employees Public transit reimbursement PTO for volunteering in the community Cha

jobs.title: Project Developer, Built Environment
jobs.description_text: Location: Denver, CO (preferred) Chicago, IL Baltimore, MD Remote in the US will be considered ROLE OVERVIEW The Project Developer, Built Environment, will execute the development of assigned solar, solar + storage, and standalone energy storage projects located in urban, commercial, and infrastructure-adjacent settings across the US. These projects are originated by the C&I sales and/or greenfield site origination teams at Pivot and will be owned by the Developer through discretionary permitting, interconnection, environmental diligence, etc., until they are transitioned to the Project Delivery team for the EPC sequence. The Project Developer will collaborate closely with other internal teams at Pivot as well as manage external contractors as needed throughout the project life cycle. This role requires strong organizational skills, comfort navigating complex jurisdictional environments w/ ambiguous or novel paths to permit approvals, and the ability to manage stakeholder views on multiple projects with clear communication and attention to detail. Among other things, this role will own the project development responsibility from receipt of site through transition to project delivery (construction, pre-NTP) with a primary focus on interconnection, site diligence and permitting for renewable energy facilities with a focus on C&I projects (rooftop, ground-mount, or carport PV; battery energy storage, e.g.) and/or greenfield energy storage projects across the US. jobs.title: Real Estate Lease & Title Associate
jobs.description_text: ROLE OVERVIEW Pivot Energy is seeking a highly experienced Real Estate Lease & Title Associate with a strong background in document drafting, review, execution, and cross-functional support. The role will support development activities by drafting lease related documents to prepare projects for construction and development loan fundings. In collaboration with your Manager and the Development Team at large, this role will prepare signature-ready documents for lease agreements, amendments, assignments, affidavits title curative measures, and other documents as necessary. The ideal candidate will have at least five years of hands-on experience supporting complex real estate transactions and working collaboratively with attorneys, lenders, title companies, county clerks, and internal business units. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. This is a high-impact role designed for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and is excited to join a development team as a key player ensuring all land, title and contractual documentation is accurate, complete and properly filed to help scale Pivot’s work in the solar and energy storage industry. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS The base salary range for this position is $70,000-$90,000 depending on relevant experience, along with eligibility for the company’s substantial bonus plan, with a target bonus of 30% of an

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Project Finance
jobs.description_text: ROLE OVERVIEW The Senior Associate, Project Finance, plays a critical role in executing the financing of Pivot Energy’s projects. Where an Associate executes defined tasks within a process maintained by others, the Senior Associate carries an established process forward, running assigned facility workflows through a full cycle from prior-cycle materials with limited intervention and high accuracy. The Senior Associate will lead diligence workflows and certain funding workflows with the guidance and support of Managers and Directors, serve as the anchored owner of assigned facility workflows within Project Finance's Associate operating model, and coordinate internal and external stakeholders to ensure financing readiness and compliance across active facilities. Managers retain ownership of the financing outcome, material exceptions, negotiations, and final approvals, and the role does not include direct people management or the construction of financial models. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS The base salary range for this position is $95,000-$110,000 depending on relevant experience, along with eligibility for the company’s substantial bonus plan, with a target bonus of 30% of annual salary (prorated in the first year based on start date).

jobs.title: Vice President of Market Strategy & Policy
jobs.description_text: Location: Denver, CO (Preferred) Remote candidates will be considered ROLE OVERVIEW Pivot Energy is seeking a dynamic, experienced leader to join our team as Vice President (VP) of Market Strategy & Policy. This role is responsible for setting the policy strategy, market strategy, and accompanying goals for the markets in which Pivot participates, and then leading those outcomes. Key areas of management include market analysis, generating go-to-market plans, policy strategy and influencing, and executive sponsorship of select high-value opportunities. The VP will deliver these outcomes by building, leading, and developing a high-performing team of market strategy, policy, and market development professionals: setting priorities, allocating resources, and holding the team accountable to clear goals. Success in the role will be defined by identifying and maintaining solar, small utility, and BESS markets while maintaining and increasing Pivot’s market share in those markets. This will involve balancing resources across teams to both enter and exit markets to optimize our market mix and resources. This role is ultimately accountable for the team's preparation of and response to procurements within qualifying markets using innovative strategies to secure capacity. jobs.title: Marketing Intern – Lead Generation
jobs.description_text: Concept Reply, part of the Reply Network, is a leader in IoT solutions. We support and advise our customers in Automotive, Manufacturing, Smart Infrastructure and beyond in all aspects of Internet of Things (IoT) and Cloud Computing. From designing and developing customized IoT solutions to implementing and managing them seamlessly, Concept Reply helps customers unlock the potential of IoT. We're hiring a part-time Marketing Intern (up to 30 hours per week) to build our pipeline of qualified leads. You'll research target accounts, find the right decision-makers, and run email and LinkedIn outreach that turns cold contacts into conversations. The leads you generate go straight to our marketing team for follow-up and to our partners as new business opportunities.

jobs.title: Mid-Level Android Developer
jobs.description_text: Position Overview We are looking for a Mid-Level Android Developer to join our team as a Consultant, supporting an existing Android application with a combination of application maintenance, troubleshooting, enhancements, and new feature development. The ideal candidate has solid hands-on experience with Kotlin and native Android development, experience working with Firebase, and basic familiarity with AWS cloud services. This role requires someone comfortable working with an established codebase, investigating production issues, and delivering reliable improvements while maintaining application stability.

jobs.title: SAP Finance Support Consultant
jobs.description_text: At Syskoplan Reply, we are seeking an SAP Finance Support Consultant to join our team. The ideal candidate brings strong functional and technical expertise in SAP Financial Accounting (FI) enabling them to support day-to-day business operations, resolve system issues, and deliver functional enhancements. Candidates should have hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP S/4HANA Cloud, including the use of standard Fiori applications.

jobs.title: SAP Operations Manager
jobs.description_text: Syskoplan is seeking a proactive and highly organized Operations Manager to support the day-to-day operations of a growing SAP consulting organization. This role spans business operations, systems administration, project coordination, and leadership support, helping ensure the business runs smoothly and efficiently. The ideal candidate is a hands-on, resourceful professional who can manage competing priorities, coordinate across internal teams, other Reply companies, and external partners, and take ownership of the details that keep the organization running. Working closely with leadership, this person will also help improve processes and support the continued growth of the business.

jobs.title: Services Delivery Consultant
jobs.description_text: Spur Reply, part of the Reply Network, is a leader in go-to-market consulting. Our mission is to turn every interaction our clients have into a go-to-market advantage. We act as an extension of our client teams, providing the support, tools, and strategies to achieve important outcomes. If you tackle challenges with unmatched persistence and believe learning is critical to ongoing growth, we want you on our team. jobs.description_text: LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job. The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next. We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

We are looking for an exceptional Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled team, one of the fastest-growing units within Spotify’s Ad Sales organization. This role is perfect for someone who wakes up every morning excited to connect with clients and inspire them with the power of Spotify. You bring curiosity, resilience, and a collaborative mindset, along with a passion for building meaningful client partnerships. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how Spotify advertisers reach audiences and elevate their connection to our platform.

If you're passionate about digital advertising, thrive in a consultative sales environment, and enjoy building lasting client relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Data Scientist  - Business Analytics
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. Our team tackles some of Spotify’s most consequential strategic questions, shaping the trajectory of our business and improving the experiences of our over 700M active users across more than 180 countries. In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to identify, assess, and launch a broad range of new initiatives and product features focused on payments and payments fraud. You will also regularly assess the health of our business and identify areas of opportunity, translating these insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership. At Spotify, you'll have access to some of the richest datasets in the world and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will shape how the world listens, discovers, and connects through audio.

jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer - Backstage
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Fullstack Web Engineer to join the Backstage team, passionate about crafting the best developer experience for millions of developers in the software industry. Leveraging our thriving open-source developer experience platform, Backstage, our teams are delivering high-impact external commercial products that truly up-level the industry standard of developer experience. Whether it’s a seasoned tech company that wants to build an internal developer portal using Backstage, or smaller companies that just want to quickly and easily increase developer satisfaction, or anything in between - our squads are shipping solutions that meet platform engineering needs all across the industry. About the team You will join the Backstage Product Area where you will help play an instrumental role in improving the experience of developers at our customer companies, in our fast-growing open-source community, and at Spotify internally. If you want to make a direct impact in helping Spotify become the industry leader in developer experience, this is the role for you.

jobs.title: Growth Lead - Japan
jobs.description_text: Join Spotify's Japan Growth team and help more listeners discover the value of Spotify Premium. As part of our Markets & Subscriptions organisation, you'll play a key role in growing our subscriber base in one of Spotify's most important markets. Japan is Spotify's only single-country region, and we're entering an exciting new chapter focused on partnerships and sustainable growth. Working across marketing, product, data and commercial teams, you'll shape our growth strategy, turn customer insights into action and find new ways to connect Japanese listeners with Spotify Premium. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while developing your leadership responsibilities over time.

jobs.title: Head of Markets Strategy & Operations, Japan
jobs.description_text: The Markets team is responsible for managing Spotify’s regions and their performance across all business-relevant metrics. Our team consists of regional Managing Directors and Market Strategy & Operation Managers (MSO). We are looking for a strategic, analytically-driven and open-minded character to support our efforts in Japan. As Head of Market Strategy and Operations, you will be responsible for strategic direction based on business analysis and insights; business planning; regional operating processes; and managing cross-functional projects by building strong relationships across the company. In this position, you will work closely with global stakeholder, local functional leadership and report to the Managing Director, Japan

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Subscriptions
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business. Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention. We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions. Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager II
jobs.description_text: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business. The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Core Experience Platform
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. The Core Experience team builds the foundations that make Spotify feel connected, intuitive, and consistent wherever people listen. From Playlists to shared product capabilities, we help teams across Spotify create experiences that millions of listeners use every day. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to shape the future of these platforms. You'll set product direction, bring teams together around shared priorities, and help create the capabilities that make great listening experiences possible at scale. This is an opportunity to influence how Spotify's products evolve while making a meaningful impact on listeners and creators around the world.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Format Foundations
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening and watching feel effortless, personal, and joyful for hundreds of millions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We’re seeking a Principal Product Manager to help lead the consumer experience across Spotify’s formats, including books, podcasts, and music. Format Foundations partners with the business teams behind each format to lead innovation in how users discover, engage with, and build lasting relationships with content on Spotify. You’ll set the product vision and strategy for your area and shape feature portfolios across formats. This role sits within Format Foundations in Core Experience, partnering closely with these teams to grow their businesses through product innovation.
